content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways to HTW Berlin HTW Foundation HTW Foundation: Application Form HTW Foundation Application Form Application Form Please complete the online application form. In addition, you must submit the following documents: copy of your university entrance qualification previous academic achievements, if applicable proof of your German language skills (B2 level) passport copy short letter of motivation (What subjects do you want to study? Why? What interests and motivates you?)
